content.title: Duolingo Had a Disastrous 2025. Why BofA Thinks the Stock Can Surge in 2026.
content.summary: With much of Wall Street having soured on  Duolingo  analysts at  BofA  Securities are urging investors to buy low.  BofA upgraded Duolingo stock to Buy from Neutral in a research note Monday, though it lowered its target for the stock price to $250 from $301.  It has been weighed down by fears about how artificial-intelligence translation could affect interest in learning languages, as well as weak near-term financial guidance.
